title: Xanthe and the Machine
author: Paloma Reyes
blurb: Rosalind Zhou, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
